title: EdgeHome Private Bridge Response
description: Recommended response shape for private MIoT/Xiaomi and Matter bridges. Bridge implementations may add bounded non-secret fields; EdgeHome Harness still redacts executor evidence before trace storage.

state.description: Short bridge/device state such as accepted, applied, verified, or queued.

observed_state.description: Optional bounded post-state summary. Do not include credentials, raw tokens, private network URLs, or vendor/controller internals.
